product: Papka: a desktop file manager for Windows. A window with a folder tree on the left, a file list on the right and a toolbar above the list.

candidates.title: Preview pane for the selected file
candidates.what: Selecting a file shows its preview and details in a pane on the right, without opening it.
candidates.press: Select a file in the list. Then switch the variant.

candidates.title: Rename in place
candidates.what: Pressing Rename turns the file name into an editable field right in the list; Enter saves it.
candidates.press: Select a file, press Rename, type a new name and press Enter.
